op.description: one of find, update, insert, delete, save

description: The batch of requests was generated on 2026‑06‑15 at 12:45 UTC by the integration‑service running in the production environment. Request #1 (sequence 1) is a **find** operation on the **customer** entity, pulling records where the **status** field equals “active”. The query returns the fields **name**, **email** and **lastLogin**, limited to 25 results, with no offset, and sorted by **lastLogin** in descending order. Request #2 (sequence 2) is an **update** against the **order** entity, targeting all orders whose **status** is “pending”. The update sets **status** to “processed” and records the processing timestamp as 2026‑06‑15T12:30:00Z; the operation is not an upsert and is applied to multiple matching documents. Finally, request #3 (sequence 3) is an **insert** into the **product** collection, adding a new document with SKU “ABC‑123”, name “Widget Pro”, price 49.99, availability set to true, and belonging to the categories “gadgets” and “tools”.
